# Windows Central

> > Windows Central is the leading source for Microsoft, Windows, Xbox, and PC gaming news, covering hardware, software, gaming platforms, and emerging technologies across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Windows Central provides comprehensive coverage of Microsoft's products and services, including Windows 11, Xbox gaming (Project Helix, Xbox Ally X), Microsoft Teams, Copilot AI, and hardware innovations. The site also covers competitive tech landscape developments like Apple's MacBook Neo, gaming industry news from Blizzard and Valve, and enterprise technology trends affecting developers and IT professionals.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft
- Xbox

- Project Helix
- MacBook Neo
- Xbox Ally X
